tools.description: Find code examples, official documentation, repository discussions or agent skills for a development task.
Search Built In public technology jobs by keyword, with pages1–100 and source ordering. Returns job URLs and company slugs for detail lookups. No location or remote filters in this initial contract.

Start here to find a model slug (e.g. `claude-fable-5-1-high`) for get_model or list_model_providers, to rank models by intelligence, price or speed, or with `slug` to fetch one known model/effort row (legacy slugs included) without paging the whole table.

Read one company profile by returned slug: description, website, logo, source employee count and industries. Headcount is a public source observation; founding year omitted because source metadata is unreliable.
You need the contact details of a Delaware registered agent named on an entity record, or the full list of agents the Division publishes.

Read video metadata, description and any available transcript. Transcript availability is not guaranteed. Not channel listings, comments or timestamped captions. Scrape pricing per successful attempt: 1 credit base, plus 4 for audio and 4 for video (5 for either, 9 for both), before other Scrape surcharges. The wrapper adds no charge; underlying Scrape requests are billed separately at their current rate. Invalid YouTube Markdown may trigger one fresh Scrape call.
